quarterly_data.signal: As of October 31, 2025 Keysight's backlog was approximately $2,697 million versus approximately $2,375 million as of October 31, 2024, the increase driven by incremental backlog from acquisitions (mainly Spirent) and orders in excess of revenue; the majority of backlog is expected to be recognized as revenue within six months. Remaining performance obligations (excluding contracts with an original expected duration of one year or less) were approximately $629 million as of October 31, 2025, with 51 percent expected to be fulfilled in 2026, 35 percent in 2027 and 14 percent thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog ~$2,697 million (vs ~$2,375 million); RPO ~$629 million (51% 2026, 35% 2027, 14% thereafter)

quarterly_data.signal: Commercial communications revenue was approximately 67 percent of Communications Solutions Group revenue in 2025 and increased 10 percent compared to 2024, primarily driven by R&D investments in terabit solutions and expanding 400G/800G transceiver manufacturing capacity to meet rising demand for AI; investment in high-speed networks for AI in the data center infrastructure ecosystem drove demand for Keysight's 400G/800G Ethernet solutions in both R&D and manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: commercial communications ~67% of CSG revenue, +10% in 2025
